defs.def: in, at or to a place that you do not know or do not mention by name 在某处；到某处pron.

ex.s: The best way to ease pressure on over-touristed destinations is to go somewhere else.
ex.t: 缓解游客过多目的地压力的最好办法，是去别的地方。

ex.s: Somewhere in the building, there was also a library, a cafeteria, and a gym.
ex.t: 大楼里的某个地方还有一间图书馆、一个食堂和一间健身房。

ex.s: Somewhere along the way, however, I lost touch with my creative self.
ex.t: 然而在某个时候我与创造性的自我失去了联系。

ex.s: Somewhere along the way, the same parent ends up becoming an invaluable member of the team.
ex.t: 不知不觉间，同一位家长最终成了球队里不可或缺的一员。
许多人来到了这家新酒店。

ex.s: Why don’t I help?” 2At first, his plan was to earn money to build a single well somewhere in Africa.
ex.t: 我为何不帮忙呢? 2A首先，他的计划是在非洲某处建造一口井赚钱。

ex.s: Kind regards, Diana Memorable moments Like a musical symphony, life has high and low moments, and somewhere in between are those moments we call “bittersweet”.
ex.t: 与音乐交响曲一样，生活有高有低,

ex.s: Poor Clark Kent will have to find somewhere else to change!
ex.t: 可怜的克拉克・肯特必须另找地方换衣服

ex.s: A dog is barking somewhere down the lane, And chickens sit atop the mulberry tree.
ex.t: 一只狗在巷子那头汪汪叫，鸡儿栖在桑树梢。

ex.s: I shall be telling this with a sigh Somewhere ages and ages hence: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I I took the one less traveled by, And that has made all the difference.
ex.t: 我将在很久很久以后，带着一声叹息讲述这一切：两条路在树林里分岔，而我——我选择了少有人走的那条，这就造成了所有的不同。
